translate_en|mods/GrowingUp/42/media/lua: Choose a childhood survival story, age at the rate selected in the story menu, and follow persistent clues and goals. Driving practice opens at 10 or through study; adulthood begins at 18.
Lets an account whose child died join again as a new child with the same callsign and party seat. This is replacement, not resurrection.
Story Party supports two to four child players.
The shared opening story. The Host screen writes this when you pick a story; before_the_frost is the network-ready one.
Every new Story Party member begins between 8 and 14 years old.
Runs Growing Up as an online cooperative sandbox campaign. Players connect normally, then accept the in-game story invitation. Choosing a story on the Host screen sets this up for you.
Normal hosted server; no Challenges tab required
Makes this normal hosted server child-only, enables Story Party, disables PVP, and selects the shared story spawn.
Nobody messed with you at recess. You're bigger than the other kids, meaner too — but not exactly honor roll material.
Everything scares you. You cry at thunderstorms, eat when you're nervous, and the other kids never let you forget it. Good luck.
Fastest kid at school and MVP of the Little League team. Strong, brave, and always first picked — but books put you right to sleep.
You devoured every Goosebumps book the school library had. You learn fast and read faster, but you bruise easy and loud noises make you jump.
You spent every summer at the creek catching crawdads and building forts. You know the woods like the back of your hand.
You always tagged along with the older kids but never said much. Nobody notices you — and honestly, that's how you like it.
You are a child. Small, weak, and scared. You'll grow out of it... if you survive.
